features:
Core Monk features through level 4 (Unarmored Defense, Martial Arts, Ki, Flurry of Blows / Patient Defense / Step of the Wind, Unarmored Movement, Monastic Tradition, Deflect Missiles, Ability Score Improvement, Slow Fall) — use the Class Reference panel below for the current SRD text.

Way of Shadow (subclass, chosen at 3rd level) — stealth- and assassination-focused monk tradition; practitioners are often called ninjas or shadowdancers. Source: Player's Handbook / Xanathar's Guide to Everything (not in the open SRD, so summarized here rather than quoted).

- Shadow Arts (3rd level): spend 2 ki to cast Darkness, Darkvision, Pass without Trace, or Silence with no material components. Also grants the Minor Illusion cantrip.
- Shadow Step (6th level): while in dim light or darkness, bonus action to teleport up to 60 ft to an unoccupied space you can see that's also dim/dark, then advantage on the first melee attack you make that turn.
- Cloak of Shadows (11th level): while in dim light or darkness, use your action to turn invisible until you attack, cast a spell, or step into bright light.
- Opportunist (17th level): when a creature within 5 ft of you is hit by someone else's attack, use your reaction to make a melee attack against it.
notes:
Catchphrase: "These hands."

Per Moss’s dream (S10): saw his mother murdered by a figure resembling his father as a kid.

Confirmed (S10, via the pipe man’s orb): that father is Dr. Tombs. The rest of the party doesn’t know this yet.

Told Bingus (S9): not interested in "the wish" — wants revenge.

Multiclass leaning (next level-up): Sorcerer, Shadow Magic origin — story reasons win out over Warlock here, since an inherited bloodline (Eyes of the Dark, Strength of the Grave) fits a necromancer father better than a warlock's pact framing. Long-rest slots, so it doesn't pair with Ki as cleanly, but that's the tradeoff.

Backup if Sorcerer doesn't pan out: 2 levels of Fighter for Action Surge + Second Wind — barely dents Monk progression, zero stat investment.

Close-range spell picks (not just the Shadow Magic origin features): Shocking Grasp (cantrip, touch, melee spell attack, shuts down the target's reaction) and Poison Spray (cantrip, 10 ft, save-based backup for when Shocking Grasp whiffs) as the starting pair. Thunderwave (1st level, self-centered push) for when he's surrounded. Long-term goal once he's deeper into Sorcerer: Vampiric Touch (3rd level, melee spell attack, necrotic, heals him for half the damage dealt) — the real echo of Dr. Tombs' necromancy.
